name: acryl-db-sqlite
description: The SQLite provider of the db port: one node:sqlite file in the app home (WAL), the app's numbered migrations applied on start, db provided to plugins. Vendored from ACRYL.
mount: mount it after instance, either as a row in blend.yaml (`- id: db` / `name: acryl-db-sqlite` / `config: { migrations: migrations }`, registered in src/app.ts as 'acryl-db-sqlite') or as root.plugin(dbSqlite, { migrations: 'migrations' }); a relative path is read from the app's folder, and the migrations/ folder (001-name.sql, ...) sits next to src/. Then a plugin that declares inject: ['db'] calls await ctx.db.all('SELECT ...', value)
